lambda_selection_rule: fairness-first: max Jain fairness and lower zero-satisfaction subject to validation NDCG within 10% of average aggregation
alpha_selection_rule: minority-first: max minority-cluster satisfaction and lower minority zero-rate subject to validation NDCG within 10% of Nash
normalization: per-member min-max normalization before group aggregation
dbscan_minority_nash: normalized Nash score + alpha * normalized minority score + 0.25 * alpha * normalized worst-member score
